reason: I already got burned in a data breach and I'm not handing a startup my address or phone so I can browse listings and then file somewhere else myself. If I'm searching my case I'll go to the official notice, not lawsuitai.org.
objection: I don't want a startup storing my identity details — making an account is the whole problem, not a feature.
would_change_my_mind: If I could search my named breach and open the official claim form with no account and no name, address, or phone collected.
